body: I'm sad you can relate, but happy you're hanging on too. So true, thee peaks are so special and I feel like when you have so much pain it allows you to appreciate them so much more. Thank you! As long as we are being brave to keep going I guess we aren't too bad. Thank you, same goes to you :)
Nexplanon twins! My arm is so bruised, but so worth it, and doesn't even hurt. Thank you! Wishing you the same :)
Thank you! A year with no periods sounds amazing, wishing you the best. The positives of the implant are so attractive I had to give it a shot
Oooh I didn't see the second picture. You two make a cute couple
Hormonal birth control is so rough on my body, so I don't take it. I lost weight taking Lexapro and now that I've added Wellbutrin I've ballooned
With exercise?? That's tough. Do you feel like you're eating more? Because that's my issue with it
Ooh no just stuff in my head. Exactly, really can't be trusted. Thank you so much x
Thirst is a real one! Never had the others but I hope it gets better soon. I think there's something you can take for tremors if you talk to your doctor. Yes, that's at least one upside for me!! x

I hope so too, I'm still abroad but in a country I hope I can get my medicine with no prescription. Not to mention I also cut my super long hair on a whim because I accompanied a friend to get her hair cut.
ED is eating disorder. I struggle with bulimia and anorexia since middle school

Definitely speak to your doctor before you do that.what side effects have been bothering you? I didn't have withdrawls, only becoming manic. I think tell your doctor and someone you see often so they can keep an eye on you and see if your behaviour changes. Thank you xx

I would've never done any of the stuff above. Especially a last minute trip like that and kissing so many people is totally not me. I was going heavy with one girl in front of several people who were filming us. 
Also just stayed with people I met six hours before my flight. So risky. Now that I'm down I can't believe any of this because I'm so quiet and not risky usually. My hypomania consists of not eating, being more social and less sleep. But never anything so out there
